7.4 Enabling/Disabling wakeup notification
[SWS_CanTrcv_00171] ⌈CanTrcv driver shall use the following APIs provided by ICU
driver, to enable and disable the wakeup event notification:
• Icu_EnableNotification
• Icu_DisableNotification
CanTrcv driver shall enable/disable ICU channels only if reference is configured for the
parameter CanTrcvIcuChannelRef.⌋
CanTrcv driver shall ensure the following to avoid the loss of wakeup events:
[SWS_CanTrcv_00172] ⌈It shall enable the ICU channels when the transceiver transi-
tions to the Standby mode (CANTRCV_STANDBY).⌋
[SWS_CanTrcv_00173] ⌈It shall disable the ICU channels when the transceiver tran-
sitions to the Normal mode (CANTRCV_NORMAL).⌋
